headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.6.0-modder.26
summary: Add an experimental Addon tab with MagicLoader support, including a development notice when you open it. Patch loader libraries now load after libminecraftpe.so for more reliable launches.

items.text: Add an Addon tab to the launcher.
Add MagicLoader support to the Addon tab.
Show a development notice when opening the Addon tab.
Load patch loader libraries after libminecraftpe.so.
Fix patch loader initialization order during launch.
Improve launch compatibility with patched Minecraft libraries.
Make patched-APK launches pass the loader's JNI checks and activate the patch, including on relaunches.
